- Fixed: Settings tab data-loaders (`templates`, `agents`, `logs`) no longer fire in a tight reactive loop when the backend returns an empty array — replaced `array.length === 0` guards with `loaded` flag state (`templatesLoaded`, `agentsLoaded`, `logsLoaded`); the `$effect` now fires exactly once per initial tab open and short-circuits on subsequent visits; mutations (create/delete/rename) call `loadTemplates()` / `loadAgents()` directly rather than resetting the flag (Relates to #2261)
- Fixed: `handleDataChanged` and `handleReload` in `Editor.svelte` now guard against null `$activeNote` at the **top** of the handler — before the `await api.readNote()` call — so the close-path fails safe by policy rather than by accident; the prior fix (#2237) placed the guard after the await, where a crash on `null.meta` inside the async body could swallow the guard entirely; the rule "refresh handlers no-op on empty state" is now expressed in code at the first line, not achieved accidentally by exception (Relates to #2214)
- Fixed: Editor.handleDataChanged[reload-meta] no longer resurrects `$activeNote` after an intentional close — the handler now checks `get(activeNote)` after the async `api.readNote()` resolves and skips the `activeNote.set()` if the store is null (intentional close) or the note ID no longer matches (note switched); same guard applied to `handleReload[reload-meta]` (AI-edit path) for class consistency (Relates to #2214)
- Fixed: note panel no longer re-opens immediately after an intentional close (Esc key, ✕ button, click-outside, or delete confirm) — the `$activeNote→fvNoteOpen` `$effect` read `fvNoteOpen` in its debug log, creating a Svelte 5 reactive dependency; when `goBackToCards()` set `fvNoteOpen=false`, the effect woke, saw `$activeNote` still non-null, and re-asserted `fvNoteOpen=true`; fixed by (a) wrapping all `fvNoteOpen` reads inside the effect with `untrack()` to eliminate the spurious dependency, and (b) reordering `goBackToCards()` to null `$activeNote` before `fvNoteOpen` so the effect sees null and skips the re-open branch even when `$state`/store batching diverges (Relates to #2214)
- Fixed: delete with note panel open no longer leaves the panel visible after confirm — Svelte 5's fine-grained `{#key}` signal for `$activeNote.meta.id` was evaluated independently from its parent `{#if $activeNote}` guard during the reactive flush triggered by `goBackToCards()`; when `$activeNote` was null, `null.meta` threw `TypeError: null is not an object`, aborting the flush before the `{#if fvNoteOpen}` DOM teardown completed and leaving the panel open; fixed by inverting the `{#key}`/`{#if}` nesting so the null-safe `{#key $activeNote?.meta?.id}` outer block never triggers prop evaluation when `$activeNote` is null, and the `{#if $activeNote}` inner guard prevents Editor mounting during key-block recreation (Relates to #2214)
- Fixed: context-menu delete (calm case — note is open, user RC-clicks that note’s card) no longer leaves the panel open after confirm — `goBackToCards()` now calls `noteService.cancelPendingSelection()` so any in-flight `selectNote` async is discarded and cannot restore `$activeNote` (triggering `fvNoteOpen=true`) after the panel was intentionally closed; added permanent flag-gated diagnostics (`localStorage.pane-debug=1`) with `[PANE-DEBUG]` prefix at the guard, `goBackToCards` entry, and all `selectedProjectNote`/`fvNoteOpen` writes (#2174 regression)
- Fixed: context-menu delete no longer leaves the note panel open when a concurrent card click creates a race between `selectedProjectNote` (sync) and `$activeNote` (async) — `confirmDeleteNote()` guard now checks `selectedProjectNote?.id` first (set synchronously at click time, always stable); `selectNote()` in `noteService.ts` now tracks a monotonic sequence counter and discards out-of-order API responses so `$activeNote` can never hold a stale note from an earlier click (#2174)
- Fixed: category changes (assign, rename, delete) now emit `pane-data-changed` so all consumers (Sidebar, NotesBrowser filter) refresh without a page reload — `setProjectCategory`, `renameCategory`, and `deleteCategory` in `api.ts` now dispatch `pane-data-changed` after their `invoke()` calls, matching the existing mutation→dispatch pattern (#2174)
- Fixed: moving a note via the editor folder pill now closes the note panel — added `onMoved` callback sibling to the existing `onDelete` pattern; dispatches `pane-data-changed` so the source folder card list refreshes without a Rust change (#2221)
- Fixed: removed six `[PROBE-2217]` diagnostic console.log statements from `NotesBrowser.svelte` (4) and `AllTasksView.svelte` (2) added in #2219 — probes served their purpose verifying #2217 fixes
- Fixed: onboarding no longer creates `memory.md`, `soul.md`, `rules.md` as permanent notes in Projects/My Notes/General/; workshop notes are purged on completion and system files persist only in `.pane/system/{UUID}/` (#2213)
- Fixed: context-menu delete no longer leaves the note panel open when `$activeNote` is null (null-gap state from #2192) — guard now checks `fvNoteOpen && !$activeNote` in addition to ID match; also removed dead `deleteNote()` function (zero call sites) (#2214)
- Fixed: moving a note to another folder now immediately removes the card from the source folder — added optimistic local filter before DB refresh; switched `pane-note-changed` listener from DOM `addEventListener` (invisible to Tauri IPC events) to Tauri `listen()` in `NotesBrowser` and `AllTasksView`, matching the working `Sidebar` pattern (#2215)
- Fixed: pill dropdowns (status, priority, due date, folder) in folder view, project view, and kanban now render unclipped — switched from `position: absolute` to `position: fixed` with viewport coords from `getBoundingClientRect()`, escaping `overflow: hidden` on `.title-row`, `.editor-wrapper`, and `.fv-note` ancestors; dropdowns close on scroll/resize so they cannot float detached (#2205)

### Fixed
- **Project brief now injected into AI context (#2156):** `build_context_prompt` now reads `projects.description` and injects it as `Project brief: {text}` immediately after the project name. Empty/whitespace briefs are skipped; briefs over 500 characters are soft-truncated with `…` (storage is untouched).

### Added
- **Toolbar responsive overflow (#2123):** editor toolbar collapses 10 formatting items (Link, Attachment link, Code Block, Undo, Redo, Version History, Pin, Checklist, Due Today, Attach File) into a “Formatting” group at the top of the ⋯ menu when the toolbar width drops below 330 px (ResizeObserver-driven). Always-visible items (B, I, S, T, H1, H2, H3, •, 1.) and the ⋯ button never clip.

No due-date, status, or checkbox affordances on any template surface.
- **Templates backend (§32, ADR-0058, #193):** new `templates` table (schema v74, CRR-synced) and Tauri commands: `list_templates`, `get_template`, `save_template`, `overwrite_template`, `rename_template`, `delete_template`, `apply_template`, `list_templates_by_name`. `apply_template` is fully atomic (body write + subtask inserts in a single transaction) and stamps `data-date` on due-today sentinels server-side at apply time.
- **Due Today block (§31.2):** new editor block that shows a snapshot of all tasks and subtasks due on a specific date. Supports check-off, row routing to the source note, date chip with calendar picker, empty state, and done-inclusive display per spec.
- **Subtask notifications routing:** clicking a subtask notification in the drawer now navigates to the parent note and highlights the specific subtask row (cyan ring + fading flash).
- **Subtask tag in drawer:** subtask notification rows now display a "Subtask" monospace badge per §31.2.7.

- **Project brief content now persists across saves and navigation (#2140):** `get_project_settings` now reads `projects.description` and `update_project_settings` now writes it. Previously the Project Brief textarea was hardcoded to empty on every load.
- **Toolbar overflow now triggers based on measured content width instead of fixed 330px threshold (#2135):** prevents icon clipping at intermediate widths; the ⋯ button is always visible and reachable regardless of panel size.
- **⌘⇧T regression (#2130):** Templates picker now opens reliably via a capture-phase `window.keydown` listener that fires before ProseMirror, ensuring \u2318\u21e7T works regardless of TipTap extension state or editor focus.
- Notification drawer rows now show a status dot (cyan unread / grey read) instead of icon tile
- Checklist now reads note ID from `activeNote` store (fixes empty state on insert)
- Checklist block no longer disappears after navigation: generic `data-component` serializer in `convertNodeToMarkdown` preserves the block as a raw-HTML block in the `.md` file; any future custom blocks with `data-component` automatically inherit this fix
- Checklist block no longer shows unwanted teal selection highlight on insert: `selectable: false` prevents `NodeSelection`, scoped `::selection { background: transparent }` suppresses browser fill wash

## [0.68.28] - 2026-07-15

### Fixed
- **File watcher no longer silently skips notes inside a project named "Assets"** — `should_skip()` in `watcher.rs` used a flat path-component scan that returned `true` for any component named `"Assets"`, causing a project directory literally named "Assets" (`Projects/Assets/`) to match the attachment-subdirectory exclusion added in #1814. This is a data-loss class bug: notes were written to disk but never ingested into SQLite. Replaced the flat scan with a depth-aware check via the extracted `is_project_assets_subdir()` helper: the skip fires only when `"Assets"` appears at component index 2 (the subfolder slot — `Projects/{name}/Assets/`), never at index 1 (the project-name slot — `Projects/Assets/`). The `#1814` attachment double-ingestion protection is fully preserved. Relates to #1824

## [0.68.27] - 2026-07-15

### Fixed
- **Gateway OC subscription channel is now unbounded — eliminates WebSocket 1006 disconnect under load** — `oc_client.rs` subscription channel was `mpsc::channel(100)` (bounded). `sender.send(value.clone()).await` at the broadcast site stalled the WS read loop when the SSE consumer was slow, leaving OC pings unanswered and causing OC to close the socket (1006 abnormal closure; 1,931 occurrences since Jul 8). Changed to `mpsc::unbounded_channel()`: `subscriptions` field type updated to `Vec<UnboundedSender<Value>>`, `subscribe()` return type updated to `UnboundedReceiver<Value>`, and the broadcast send drops `.await` (unbounded send is sync). Worst-case memory at peak agentic-loop rate: ~3 MB for a 30-second stall — safe on all target hardware. Dead consumers return `Err` immediately, zero accumulation. Relates to #1998
- **Anthropic streaming now preserves partial text on mid-stream error** — `stream_anthropic` in `anthropic.rs` previously used `?` on chunk errors, silently dropping all accumulated response text. The error return type is now `StreamAnthropicError = (String, String)` (mirroring `StreamOpenrouterError`), the mid-stream `?` is replaced with an explicit match that clones `full_text` into the error tuple, and the four call sites in `commands.rs` no longer overwrite partial text with `String::new()`. The `should_smart_route_retry` gate in `commands.rs` now correctly suppresses retry when text had already streamed. Relates to #1554
- **User message no longer duplicated when AI response times out and retries** — `handleSendMessage` in `ChatSidebar.svelte` now gates user-message creation and DB persistence behind `if (!isRetry)`. On timeout, the empty-response retry path (`isRetry: true`) reuses the original message already in `allMessages` and the DB instead of inserting a second row. `isStreaming = true` is preserved outside the gate so the retry stream initialises correctly. Relates to #1957

## [0.68.26] - 2026-07-15

### Changed
- **Project favorites now backed by DB column instead of localStorage** — `projects.is_favorite INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` replaces the `pane_pinned_projects` localStorage key. The `$pinnedProjectIds` Svelte store is removed; all seven consumer components (`Sidebar`, `ProjectsView`, `AllTasksView`, `ProjectContextMenu`, `ProjectSettings`, `ChatSidebar`, `+page`) now read `project.is_favorite` directly off the `$projects` store. The sidebar's `pinnedProjects` derived re-evaluates reactively on any DB reload, eliminating the stale-sidebar bug where a newly-favorited project wasn't visible until clicking All Projects. `execute_star_project` (AI tool) now writes `UPDATE projects SET is_favorite = ?` instead of `ai_settings`; `update_project_settings` gains `is_favorite: Option<bool>`. Relates to #2009, Relates to #2004

### Fixed
- **AI conversation no longer disappears when switching from Project view to Folder view mid-session** — `handleNavigationComplete` in `ChatSidebar.svelte` unconditionally wiped `allMessages` for the active thread on every `navigateTo()` call, including same-session view switches where the threadId doesn't change. Three targeted fixes: (1) the clear is now gated on a real session change (`threadId !== previousThreadId`); (2) the streaming placeholder is never filtered out during a clear even on a genuine session switch; (3) `consumePendingResult` is now wired into the nav-complete handler to close the race where `onDone` fires between the STEP-4 DB snapshot and the handler. Frontend-only, no backend/persistence changes. Relates to #2051
- **Completed `pane-note-created` migration** — `Sidebar.svelte` now listens for `pane-note-created` so new notes appear immediately in the sidebar without a reload. `SubtaskPanel.svelte` (dead code, never mounted) removed. `pane-data-changed` removed from the four create-path functions (`createNote`, `createNoteInProject`, `quickCaptureNote`, `createNoteFromLink`) in `api.ts` — those paths now dispatch only `pane-note-created`. `syncStore.ts` gained a matching `pane-note-created` listener so auto-sync continues to fire on note creation. Edit/save paths unchanged. `Editor.svelte.before_patch` backup artifact deleted. Relates to #2050, #2062, #2064, #2067 (spec-skip: hygiene cleanup — removes dead code and completes event listener migration started in #2064, no behavioral change)
- Fixed infinite refresh loop on Project/Kanban view caused by overly-broad `pane-data-changed` listener; introduced `pane-note-created` event for structural note creation (#2050)
- **AI-created notes on the Project/Kanban view now appear immediately without requiring navigation away and back** (#2050)
- **Onboarding memory/soul/rules edits via AI chat were silently discarded** — the done handler parsed tool call args using `tc.function?.arguments || tc.input` but the backend emits canonical format `{ id, name, params }`. `tc.params` was never checked, so `editedNoteId` was always `undefined`, the post-edit note refresh was skipped, and `saveAndComplete` wrote the stale pre-edit draft to disk. Added `|| tc.params` to the fallback chain so the refresh fires and the AI's edited content is correctly written to `MEMORY.md`/`SOUL.md`/`RULES.md` on Finish. (#2049)
- Manual backup no longer blocks the UI thread (~37s freeze); runs on background thread with phase-based progress events (#1921)
- Backup now flushes pending file-watcher events before snapshot, preventing notes typed within 2s debounce window from being missed (#1923)
- WAL checkpoint result is now inspected and logged; partial/blocked checkpoints surface a diagnostic (#1923)
- Restore corruption: close live DB connection, clear WAL/SHM sidecars, and use atomic rename for crash-safe restore (#1922)
- Schema version check now reads real version from ai_settings instead of dead PRAGMA user_version
- **App zoom (⌘+/⌘-/⌘0) no longer clips content at the window edge** — `document.body.style.zoom` was scaling the body inside a fixed CSS viewport; `.app { overflow: hidden }` then clipped the scaled content at the window edge, making it unreachable. Replaced with `getCurrentWebview().setZoom(zoomLevel)` (Tauri v2 `core:webview:allow-set-webview-zoom` permission), which delegates to `WKWebView.setPageZoom()`. At zoom > 1×, the entire page renders at the zoomed scale and WKWebView's native scroll view provides access to overflowing content. Permission added to `src-tauri/capabilities/default.json`. `$effect` falls back to `zoomLevel = 1.0` and clears localStorage if `setZoom()` rejects. Relates to #2007
- **Sidebar favorites no longer go blank on project reload** — `listProjects()` and `syncProjectsWithNotebooks()` in `api.ts` used explicit field-by-field TS object mapping that omitted `is_favorite`. After any `$projects` reload through these functions, every project had `is_favorite: undefined`, causing sidebar favorites to disappear. Added `is_favorite: p.is_favorite ?? false` to both mapping sites. Relates to #2009, Relates to #2038
- **Project store now refreshes immediately after create** — `create_project` in `projects.rs` was the only project mutation that did not emit `pane-project-changed`. It had no `AppHandle` parameter and therefore could not emit, leaving `$projects` stale after create. Navigation immediately after create logged `[NAV] Project not found` and the sidebar couldn't render the new project as a favorite. Added `app: tauri::AppHandle` to `create_project` and emit `pane-project-changed` on success, matching the existing `update_project_settings` pattern. Relates to #2009
- **Smart Features API key now persists correctly after save** — `get_ai_setting` for `internal_api_key` was reading SQLite only; after the first save, `write_internal_key` stores the key in keychain and deletes the SQLite row, so every subsequent read returned empty. Added a keychain-routing intercept in `get_ai_setting_impl` that mirrors the write-path intercept in `set_ai_setting`, closing the read/write backend mismatch. Round-trip set→get now returns the same value in all cases. Relates to #2008
- **Model field no longer populates Custom Model ID after Settings reopen** — `loadAiConfig` contained a hardcoded `standardModels` array that checked the saved model before `loadAvailableModels()` resolved. Any model absent from this stale list caused `showCustomModelInput = true` and `customModelInput = model` to be set; the live-catalog block later corrected the picker but never cleared the custom-input state, leaving both the main picker (correct) and the Custom Model ID field (stale) visible simultaneously. Deleted the hardcoded block entirely. The live catalog now fully owns model display state; no hardcoded model IDs remain in `Settings.svelte`. Relates to #2008
- **OC sync: stale gateway token now shows an actionable recovery message instead of an opaque 502** — `GatewayError::OcHandshakeTimeout` is introduced for the hello-ok-timeout arm (`oc_client.rs`, the 10 s `timeout(Duration::from_secs(10), hello_rx)` expiry). The gateway maps it to HTTP 502 with `error: "oc_handshake_timeout"` in the structured body. `fetch_gateway_agents` parses the body on non-2xx responses: `oc_handshake_timeout` fast-fails immediately (no retry, since a stale token cannot be cured by retrying); other error codes still retry up to 3 times. Both `Onboarding.svelte` and `Settings.svelte` discriminate on the code and render the §22C.5.4 recovery message naming the stale `OC_BEARER_TOKEN`, how to find and update it, and how to restart the Pane gateway. Relates to #2025 (#2025, spec-covered-by: #2026)
- **Sync: all gateway client paths now use SPKI-pinned TLS; fixes initial sync and migration file fetch** — `initial_sync` was passing `cert_pem = None` to `fetch_gateway_agents`, silently falling back to `danger_accept_invalid_certs` even after pairing. Fixed: `sync_initial_import` now pre-reads `gateway_tls_cert_pem` from DB and passes it through. `fetch_migration_files` was rolling its own raw `reqwest::blocking::Client` with `danger_accept_invalid_certs(true)`; replaced with `build_gateway_client_blocking_with_cert` using the same DB cert source (#2011)
- **Gateway TLS: SPKI pubkey pin replaces hostname/SAN verification; fixes connectivity over Tailscale IPv4** — The self-signed cert SAN list may omit the Tailscale IPv4 the app connects by. A custom `PinnedCertVerifier` now pins the SHA-256 hash of the server's SubjectPublicKeyInfo (HPKP-style, RFC 7469 §2.4) and skips hostname/SAN checks entirely. Both the async and blocking reqwest client builders use `use_preconfigured_tls` with this verifier. Gateway-side `compute_fingerprint()` likewise switches to SPKI-hash so the pairing UI shows the correct pin (#2011)
- **Hiding the last visible session on a surface is now blocked in the UI** — `SessionRow` accepts a new `isLastVisible` prop; when true the Hide menu item is disabled (greyed, `cursor:not-allowed`) and shows tooltip "Cannot hide the only visible session". Both `SessionDropdownHeader` (Project dropdown) and `SessionsDrawer` (Home drawer) pass this prop when only one visible session remains. Previously hiding the last session triggered the backend’s born-active create-if-none (§30.2.5), spawning a phantom session and surfacing a spurious “hide failed” error. Also fixed three latent `loadSessions(…, false)` call sites in `sessionStore.ts` (`createSession`, `switchSession`, `renameSession`) — these were silently dropping hidden sessions from the store after any of these operations, corrupting the Hidden group. A regression guard test now asserts no `loadSessions(…, false)` call sites remain in `sessionStore.ts` (#395)
- **Session row context menu now flips upward when near bottom of dropdown to avoid clipping** — ported `position: fixed` + viewport-aware flip pattern from `SearchableModelSelect`; `z-index` raised to 300 to clear `.sdh-dropdown` at 200; orphaned JSDoc comment removed from `SessionsDrawer` (#395)
- **Hide-session now immediately shows Hidden group, added inactive status dots, increased row spacing, removed session-count badge** — `hideSession` now re-fetches with `include_hidden=true` so hidden sessions stay in the store and the Hidden group remains visible; inactive non-hidden session rows now show a subtle status dot; `SessionDropdownHeader` and `SessionsDrawer` lists use `gap: 4px` for breathing room; session-count badge removed from drawer toggle strip (#395)
- **Session UI design corrections** — Lucide SVG icons replace emoji for hide/unhide buttons in `SessionRow`; removed redundant "Just this one so far" single-session headline from both Project dropdown and Home drawer; removed duplicate New Session button (`sdh-new-btn`) from `SessionDropdownHeader` header bar (dropdown row is the sole creation path); added fresh-session hint in `ChatPanel` empty state when the active session was just created or has no messages; raised chat column max width cap from 700 to 900px (#395)
- **Session switch on Home view now reloads the message stream** — `SessionsDrawer` was mounted in `+page.svelte` without the `onSessionSwitch` prop, so switching sessions via the home drawer called into a silent no-op. The prop is now wired to `ChatSidebar.handleSessionSwitch` and declared required (not optional-chained) so any future disconnect fails loudly at compile time rather than silently at runtime (#395)
- **De-duplicated `switch_session` call in project dropdown** — `SessionDropdownHeader` was calling `loadSessions` from both a `$effect` and an `onMount`, causing every mount to fire two backend list calls and momentarily flash an empty session list. Removed the duplicate `onMount` call; the `$effect` handles all loads (#395)

### Changed
- **Gateway TLS mode default changed from Auto to SelfSigned; Tailscale and Auto modes disabled in V1** — `TlsMode::SelfSigned` is now the `#[default]` and the `unwrap_or` fallback. A runtime hard-gate (`process::exit(1)`) prevents starting the gateway with `GATEWAY_TLS_MODE=tailscale` or `=auto`; the SPKI pin model is incompatible with Let's Encrypt key rotation (#2011)

### Added
- **Home AI sessions drawer** (`SessionsDrawer.svelte`) — mounted as a flex-row sibling of the centred Home chat panel. Collapsed to a 44px toggle strip with session-count badge; expands to 320px. Two-call merge pattern (§30.2.2): workspace sessions + recovered sessions fetched in parallel and rendered in separate labelled sections. Active-first ordering, last_active_at DESC for the rest. Filter bar at ≥8 total sessions. "Just this one so far" headline at count===1 (session still renders). "Show hidden" footer toggle. W1 fix (dead `{#if isNarrow}` branch removed from pinned-top) + W2 fix (single-session headline above list, not replacing it) included. This is the final PR for #395 (#395)
- Project AI session dropdown header (`SessionDropdownHeader.svelte`) — replaces the old static `.chat-header` in the Project AI panel with a click-to-expand session switcher: project name + active session name on the bar, ▾/▴ chevron, live cyan dot, New Session button (non-destructive), per-session inline rename and hide, filter field at ≥8 sessions, hidden sessions section behind a footer toggle, responsive narrow mode at <380px, fixed positioning to escape `overflow:hidden` ancestors (#395)
- Session store (`sessionStore.ts`) with actions for create, list, switch, hide, unhide, and rename — shared foundation for Project dropdown header and Home drawer (#395)
- `SessionRow.svelte` — shared session row component with active indicator (cyan dot + left rail + soft fill), inline rename, hover ⋯ menu (Rename + Hide; never red, never a trash can), Unhide variant for hidden sessions, and compact mode (#395)
- Session filter logic: search bar threshold (≥8 sessions), title-matched filtering across visible and hidden rows with split output for "Hidden" section grouping (#395)
- Empty-state copy exports: `EMPTY_STATE_SINGLE` ("Just this one so far") for single-session surfaces; `FRESH_SESSION_NAME` ("New session") for sessions awaiting first message (#395)
- Provider-neutral canonical message format adapter — enables mid-session provider switching without wire-format errors (#395)

### Removed
- Removed surface-keyed destructive commands (`clear_chat_thread`, `clear_chat_messages`, `reset_chat_thread`) and reset pointer (`get_or_create_thread`) — superseded by session model (#395)

### Changed
- Chat messages now keyed by session id instead of project id — enables per-session history, independent compaction, and correct OC gateway hints (#395)

### Added
- Added session commands (create/list/switch/hide/unhide/rename) and born-active hook — new projects get an active chat session automatically (#395)
- Added `chat_sessions` table and v71→v72 migration for session model — creates per-device session identity, backfills legacy chat history via id-equality rule, classifies orphaned sessions as recoverable (#395)
- Added notification panel with bell toggle, row routing, dismiss, and badge refresh (#1811, resolves #822)
- Added `dismiss_notification` command; filtered dismissed rows from panel queries and badge count (#1811)
- Activated due-date watcher: app-focus, startup, and post-update triggers with auto-dismiss (#1811)
- Added due-date watcher core logic: `check_due_dates()` with overdue/due-today detection, idem-key dedup, expiry sweep (#1811)
- Added notifications schema migration: 5 new columns (`dismissed_at`, `expires_at`, `target_kind`, `target_id`, `idem_key`) and 3 indices on `notifications` table (#1811)

### Fixed
- **Badge miscount (#1811):** Sidebar bell badge now always reflects the DB via `get_unread_count`; replaced blind `unreadCount++` increment on `pane-notification` events with a `refreshBadge()` re-query. Added `pane-badge-changed` listener so backend-initiated dismissals (auto-dismiss on done, companion-clear DELETE) immediately sync the counter without waiting for user panel interaction. Fixes both Repro A (task done/todo cycle) and Repro B (due_date overdue→today) overcounts.
- **Dismissed notifications no longer reappear on focus/reload (#1811):** Removed `AND dismissed_at IS NULL` from dedup queries in `check_due_dates()` and `check_due_dates_for_task()`. Dismissed rows now act as permanent tombstones; any prior row (dismissed or active) blocks re-emit. Companion `DELETE` logic in `update_note` clears notification rows when a task is reopened from done or its due_date changes, enabling legitimate re-fire via the existing `check_due_dates_for_task` call. No schema change; no migration.
- **Notification panel polish (#1811):** Removed redundant `#task` / `#system` source tag from each notification row (every launch notification is a task; tag added no information). Fixed dismiss ×  button overlapping the timestamp on hover by giving the body padding-right when the row is hovered.
- Fixed: notification and pinned-note clicks now resolve the note's project automatically, opening the note editor instead of silently failing (#1811)
- Fixed notification panel clipping (position: absolute→fixed); added Space key support, empty-list guard fix, token-based glow color, dismiss error recovery (#1811)
- Fixed notifications inserting spurious assistant messages into Home chat (#1811): `process_notification()` was writing every notification into `chat_messages_local` with `project_id='workspace'`, causing notifications to appear as AI messages in the Home chat view, leak into AI context, FTS search, and the embeddings pipeline. The unspecced insert has been removed; only the `notifications` table row, the `pane-notification` event, and the OS-native notification are retained.
- Long user messages in chat now collapse past 8 lines with a gradient fade and Show more/Show less toggle (#1706)
- Removed misleading "Active" status indicator from agents page — showed green for all agents regardless of state (#1428)
- Temperature parameter no longer sent to models that reject it; gated on live provider metadata instead of static model lists (#1846)
- Fixed hover effect inconsistency and tooltip mismatch on New Note buttons (#1947)
- Fixed double-plus rendering on New Note buttons in folder and kanban views (#1871)
- **Kanban board regression — cabinet notes now visible (#1935, ADR-0003 cabinet amendment):** Introduced `get_project_notes_for_kanban` Tauri command (project-scoped, no status filter) so the kanban board receives cabinet-status notes that `get_tasks` correctly excludes. New `listNotesForKanban` API function on the kanban path preserves `status: 'cabinet'` instead of mapping it to `undefined`, and defaults null-status notes to `'cabinet'` instead of `'todo'`. `KanbanBoard.svelte` now uses `Promise.allSettled` so a folders-fetch failure no longer blanks the entire task list (and vice versa). `get_tasks`, All-Tasks views, task counts, and the folder view are unchanged.
- Unified editor placeholder and new-note button text across all views (#1871)
- **Notes-only schema alignment — Frontend (#1935, ADR-0003):** `isTask()` now correctly excludes cabinet-status notes; `transformNoteMeta` maps `'cabinet'` → `undefined` for `task_status`; `createTask` (hardcoded `status: 'task'`) and `promoteNoteToTask` (also hardcoded `'task'`) removed from `api.ts`; all 8 task-creation UI call sites rewritten to use `createNoteInProject` with intended workflow status; `taskService.createTask` removed; test assertions updated.
- **Notes-only schema alignment — Rust backend (#1935, ADR-0003):** `status` column enforced `NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cabinet'` across all schema sites; `idx_notes_status` predicate corrected to `WHERE status != 'cabinet'`; `get_tasks` query adds `AND status != 'cabinet'` defense-in-depth conjunct; AI un-task sets `status = 'cabinet'` (was NULL); AI task-count query excludes cabinet rows. SCHEMA_VERSION → 70.
- **Note/task creation on upgraded DBs (#1521 Phase 8 P0, launch-blocking):** `init_database()` now runs migrations on a separate short-lived connection that is dropped before the app's long-lived connection opens. Eliminates the `"unable to reset cached trigger stmt"` error class that surfaced when a mid-life migration (e.g., #1908's og_cache CREATE TABLE) bumped SQLite's `schema_cookie` on a connection that had already cached FTS5 trigger VDBE programs. Fresh installs are unaffected; upgrade paths that were failing on first INSERT after startup are fixed by construction. See ADR-0051 and `docs/spec/file-system.md` §2B.6. (Spec: #1930, code: #1931)

### Specification
- ADR-0051: Migrations run on a separate short-lived connection, dropped before the app connection opens. Class-fix for the schema-cookie mismatch that produces `"unable to reset cached trigger stmt"` on upgrade paths. §2B.6 amended to reflect the new `init_database()` pattern; §2B.1 (pre-migration backup) and §2B.2 (graceful fallthrough) unchanged. Preserves ADR-0017 / ADR-0019 per-version-pair migration model.
- ADR-0003 amended: Cabinet is a first-class `status` value (`NOT NULL DEFAULT 'cabinet'`), not the NULL sentinel. Status vocabulary closed set: `cabinet | todo | in_progress | review | done`. Task = note with workflow status (set and not 'cabinet'). Single create path; no `createTask` wrapper; no `'task'` value. Amends core-data-model.md §1.1 and §1.3.

### Changed
- Backups no longer archive the Assets/media tree in any backup type. Users should use their existing media backup solution (Time Machine, iCloud, etc.) for media. (#1915)

## [0.67.91] - 2026-07-04

### Added
- **Link preview og: enrichment** (#1780, ADR-0049 Decision 2): non-video link attachments in preview mode now fetch Open Graph metadata (`og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`) and display them in the card. The fetch is Rust-side only (never client-side), SSRF-guarded with a full private-IP blocklist (loopback, RFC1918, link-local, cloud metadata `169.254.169.254`, IPv4-mapped IPv6, multicast), 5-second timeout, 3-hop redirect cap with per-hop re-validation, and 256 KB body cap. og: data is cached in a new `og_cache` table (7-day TTL for success, 1-hour for failures). YouTube/Vimeo links continue to render the video card (#1902) unchanged.
- New `og_cache` SQLite table (schema v69 migration). URL-keyed, FK-less. Migration carries over existing `link_embeds_enabled` value to the new `link_previews_enabled` gate key for users who had toggled it off. **DB migration — Matt tests on Mac Studio before broad release.**
- Upgrade fixture `tests/fixtures/upgrade-from-v68.db` added for smoke CI gate. Stamped at schema v68 with `link_embeds_enabled='false'` seed to exercise the carry-over path in the v69 migration.
- New `link_previews_enabled` setting (replaces orphaned `link_embeds_enabled`). Disabling suppresses all og: fetch egress. Visible in Settings as "Enable link previews".
- CSP `img-src` widened to `https:` for og:image display in the WebView. `#1902`'s `https://img.youtube.com` is preserved. Tracked tradeoff per ADR-0049 v1; Rust-side og:image proxy is a follow-up.

## [0.67.89] - 2026-07-04

### Removed
- Removed iframe embed render mode for link attachments. Tauri's `tauri://localhost` opaque origin cannot send a Referer header, which causes YouTube Error 153 (Video player configuration error) — spec-level impossibility, not a bug. `resolveEmbed.ts` allowlist retained for upcoming #1902 thumbnail card. See audit `2026-07-04-embed-rip-scope.md`.

### Fixed
- Link attachment nodes in `plain` and `preview` render modes no longer show a stuck loading skeleton. Two compounding bugs are fixed: (1) `AttachmentNodeView` now has explicit branches for `link + plain` (renders a bare `<a>` anchor with the URL as text — no fetch, no loader, per LOCKED-DESIGN-SPEC) and `link + preview` (passes through to `AttachmentCard` for domain-name card rendering); (2) `AttachmentCard.isLoading` now excludes `attachmentType === 'link'` from the file-upload heuristic that was permanently true for link nodes (which legitimately have no `filename`, `attachmentId`, or `status`). Relates to #1898.

## [0.67.88] - 2026-07-04

### Added

Bare domains (e.g. `pane.so`) get `https://` prepended automatically. The modal validates leniently — empty disables the button, malformed shows an inline error, plausible enables. On submit, `insertAttachment({ attachmentType: 'link', src, renderMode: 'preview' })` inserts a preview-mode link card into the note body. ## [0.67.87] - 2026-07-03

### Added
- Link attachments now support embed render mode via `AttachmentLinkEmbed.svelte` (ADR-0050). Provider allowlist: YouTube-nocookie + Vimeo. `resolveEmbed()` parses the user URL, extracts a video ID with strict patterns, and reconstructs the canonical embed URL from a trusted template — non-allowlisted URLs fall back to the card. Iframe uses `sandbox="allow-scripts allow-same-origin"` (safe because provider is cross-origin allowlisted, per ADR-0050 §4 — inverse of ADR-0049 D1), with `allow="encrypted-media; picture-in-picture; fullscreen"` and `referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin"`. Disabled by the `link_embeds_enabled` setting (default true, disclosed in Settings). CSP `frame-src` allowlist added: `youtube-nocookie.com` + `player.vimeo.com` (default-deny for everything else). Relates to #401.

## [0.67.86] - 2026-07-03

### Added
- HTML preview mode: HTML attachments now open in a sandboxed preview modal via `AttachmentHTMLPreview.svelte`. Uses `<iframe sandbox="">` (empty sandbox — no scripts, no same-origin) with content delivered as `srcdoc` (never `data:` — blocked by app CSP). Document-level CSP meta `default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src data:` injected inline, blocking passive subresource loads per ADR-0049 Amendment B. Content never enters note contenteditable DOM. Size cap: 1 MB soft (with "Preview anyway" affordance), 5 MB hard. `<base target="_blank">` placeholder in wrapper — link egress deferred to PR7 (#1780). Relates to #401.

### Performance
- Rewrote NavPlayer EQ bar animation from `height` keyframes to `transform: scaleY()` for composite-only rendering. Eliminates continuous Composite/Paint churn during audio playback. Relates to #401.
- Removed unused SvelteKit hover-prefetch from body. Was installing a global 20ms `setTimeout` on every mousemove with no user-facing benefit (Pane uses canvasState swaps, not SvelteKit routing). Live-measured -22% CPU during NavPlayer playback. Relates to #401.

## [0.67.83] - 2026-07-03

### Fixed
- NavPlayer ↗ (go-to-note) button now navigates to the source note when it lives in a different project. Previously silent no-op because `notes` store is notebook-scoped and evicts cross-project notes. Fix uses `readNote()` IPC for lookup + `navigateTo({ view: 'notes_browser', projectId })` for project switch. Includes rapid-click guard and error toast. Relates to #401.

## [0.67.82] - 2026-07-03

### Added
- Added global nav-docked audio player (skeleton). Empty/buffering/failed/paused/playing states render in both menu widths; NodeView wiring lands in PR5b. Refs #401, #1801.
- **Nav-docked global audio player wiring** — audio attachments in Player mode now load into the sidebar player and play across note navigation. Go-to-note ↗ button jumps to the source note. (#401, #1801)

### Fixed
- Attachment audio player (NavPlayer) now correctly initiates load on mount. WKWebView on macOS does not auto-fetch `asset://` URIs for `<audio>` elements created with pre-populated `src`; explicit `.load()` call after bind:this resolves fixes it. Video/image paths unaffected (they use a different mount pattern that works). Relates to #401.
- Player mode on audio attachments now resolves asset URL via IPC before calling `loadTrack` — previously `<audio src>` received an empty string (set at insert time by the file-picker upload path) and audio never played. `handleModeChange` now calls `resolveAttachmentSrc(attachmentId)` → `asset://localhost/...` URL, mirroring `AttachmentVideoPlayer.svelte` and `AttachmentImageInline.svelte`. Empty resolve result sets `playerStatus` to `'failed'` rather than shipping an unplayable track. (#401)
- Attachment card metadata (filename, size) now survives note remount for fresh drag/paste uploads. Root cause: stale `ATTACHMENT_DEFAULT_MODES` literal map in Editor.svelte used `'collapsed-card'` for audio/video/pdf/html/file/link, mismatching `Attachment.ts:defaultRenderMode()` which returns `'card'`. Every drag/paste upload was misclassified as non-default mode and serialized through the raw-HTML path, which omitted `data-filename` and `data-size` — so cards showed generic "File / AUDIO" on remount. Fix: deleted stale map, imported `defaultRenderMode()` as single source of truth; raw-HTML wrapper now emits `data-filename`+`data-size` (belt-and-suspenders per burn-area comment); file-picker upload also updated. (#401)
- Image resize handles: fix frozen dimensions on first grab of natural-width images. Clamp drag anchor to column width at capture time so the drag math starts inside the clamp bounds. Preserves natural dims in node attrs — only the drag interaction is bounded. (#1843)
- Attachment cards now display file size in the meta line (e.g. "PDF · 6 MB · 1 page", "MP3 · 4 MB"), matching the #1774 locked design. Size is wired from the DB (`size_bytes`, already populated) through the API → node attrs → card, and the card now emits a type prefix as the first meta-line segment. Known limitation: notes attached before this fix will not show size until re-attached (old markdown was serialized without `data-size`). (#1867, #401)
- Attachment.test.ts T-D2: fixed phantom class `at-mode-button` → `at-tbtn--mode` (real production class). Test was passing for the wrong reason. (#1867)
- `AttachmentNodeView.test.ts`: updated stale audio-meta test to match #1774 format (`MP3 · 4.0 MB`, no duration segment). (#1867)

## [0.67.77] - 2026-07-02

### Fixed
- Image resize handles now respond on FIRST grab. Previously, mousedown on an unselected image's resize handle was consumed by ProseMirror as a node-drag initiator (via `draggable: true`), requiring a first grab to trigger selection and a second grab to actually resize. Fixed by adding `stopEvent` to the NodeView spec: events targeting `.at-handle` elements are yielded to Svelte's `onmousedown={startDrag}` handler, letting the drag session begin cleanly on first interaction. Drag-to-move on the rest of the node body is preserved. (#1843, #401)

## [0.67.76] - 2026-07-01

### Fixed
- Image drag no longer has a dead zone above the content-column width. `applyDrag` now clamps `currentW` to the live column width read from `getComputedStyle(.pane-editor)`, so the numeric overlay stops climbing at the visible ceiling and drag response is continuous from the first pixel. Responsive column widths below 720px are preserved (no hardcoded 720 in the clamp). (#1843, #401)
- Editor content column is now horizontally centered in the editor pane. `.pane-editor` had `max-width: 720px` but no `margin: 0 auto`, leaving the column left-pinned with all empty space on the right. (#1843, #401)

## [0.67.75] - 2026-07-01

### Fixed
- Attachment image resize now visibly tracks the drag at all widths and the selection handles hug the image edge. The `.at-image-inline` container previously expanded to fill the editor column with no width binding, so handles sat on the column edge (visible as empty space beside the image) and the `<img>` capped at column width until the dragged value dropped below column width. Container now carries `width:${currentW}px; max-width:100%` inline; the img keeps PR #1857's `min()` guard as belt-and-suspenders. (#1843, #401)

## [0.67.74] - 2026-07-01

### Fixed
- Attachment mode picker now opens on the first click after focus returns. Previously, the remount-on-select pattern in `selectNode`/`deselectNode` tore down the live NodeView on every selection event, causing the originating click to be consumed by ProseMirror's selection machinery before the freshly-mounted mode button could receive it. Selection now propagates as a reactive `selected` prop update; `update()` remains a full remount, preserving the #1835 stale-closure fix. (#1843, #401)
- Image attachment resize now scales continuously at all sizes. Previously, dragging above the ~720px editor column width had no visible effect (max-width was non-binding); resize only bit below column width. Now the width dragged directly constrains visible width while preserving aspect ratio at any size. (#1843, #401)
- Theme cascade default: `:root` now holds dark tokens as the shipping default, eliminating a Svelte 5 `$effect` timing race that could leave `data-theme="light"` set on `<html>` at cold-start for Light-mode macOS users or those with stale `pane-dark-mode=false` in localStorage. Light-theme scaffolding preserved under `[data-theme="light"]` for future light-mode feature. (#1855)
- AttachmentCard `.at-meta` color: swapped `--fg-2` → `--fg-3` to match design source `attachments.css:44`, restoring the intended dimmer meta line contrast against `.at-name`. Added missing `.at-meta b { color: var(--fg-2); font-weight: 500 }` rule. (#1843, #1855)

### Documentation
- §5.4 (memory-pipeline.md): output filter for AI-origin facts (#812, launch-blocking). New extraction step (step 3) between the extractor returning facts and the `ai_memory` write, replacing the weak prompt-instruction guard that weak models ignore. Drops assistant-origin facts mechanically via two signals: (a) a model-produced `attribution` tag (`user` vs `assistant`, tagging who the fact is *about*, not whose words articulated it) and (b) a mechanical subject/pattern backstop (first-person-AI / "you asked me to" / tool-result restatements, scoped to `fact`/`reflection`) that catches what a weak model mis-tags. Token-overlap detection was rejected — it eats legitimate decision-facts when the user is terse and the AI articulates the decision. Purely subtractive: changes nothing about which user-origin facts are extracted (extraction red line). The `attribution` tag is the hook that upgrades in place into #1711 attribution-routing (post-launch). Steps 3–5 renumber to 4–6. Spec lands before the #812 code fix cites it via `spec-covered-by:`. (#812)
- ai-integration.md §4.5.2.1 (new): Settings-UI validation for the AI-tab fields `max_tool_iterations` and `loop_timeout_seconds`. Clamp-not-reject on blur (out-of-range → nearest bound, no error state, mirroring the backend clamp); save-on-blur (no per-keystroke/debounce; steppers save immediately); empty/non-numeric on blur reverts to last-saved or the spec default (10 / 120). UI layer only — backend clamp (#1589) and loop behavior (#1587/#1588) unchanged. (Relates to #1587, #1588, #1589)
- **ai-integration.md §4.5.2:** Agentic-loop settings location changed from "Settings → General" to "Settings → AI" — `max_tool_iterations` and `loop_timeout_seconds` are AI-behavior knobs, not vault/appearance settings. Ranges, defaults, and summary string unchanged. (Relates to #1587, #1588, #1589)

### Fixed
- fix(kanban): refresh tasks on project switch (#775)
- **#1692 — `ai-stream-chunk` `done:true` no longer emits twice on clean exit or provider error.** Exit B (`tool_calls.is_empty()`) and Exit C (provider error) both emitted `done:true` inline AND fell through to an unconditional post-loop emit. Fixed by adding a `did_emit_done` guard flag before the agentic loop; the post-loop emit is now suppressed when an inline emit already fired. Exit A (iteration cap) and Exit D (wall-clock timeout) — including the #1587 summary path — are unaffected and continue to receive their single done from the post-loop site. (`Relates to #1692`) (`spec-skip: spec note added to §4.5.3 in this PR — done:true invariant`)
- **#1717 — Embedding pipeline: exclude daily-log notes with NULL/empty body from indexing.** Daily-log notes with `body=NULL` in the DB but a non-empty file scaffold (e.g. `# 2026-01-15`) previously passed the #1673 file-content guard, reached the embed API, and triggered "missing data[0].embedding" errors on every pipeline run. Fix: SQL WHERE clause now excludes `note_type='daily'` notes where `body IS NULL OR TRIM(body) = ''` at the query layer — they never enter the pipeline. Daily notes with real body content and all non-daily notes are unaffected. (`Relates to #1717`) (`spec-skip: pipeline filter fix, no behavioral change for notes with content`)
- **#641 — Memory extraction toast restored (§5.4B, launch-blocking).** Revives the `memoryToast` display path that went dark when #335 moved extraction from sync to async without wiring a replacement event path. Four pieces: (1) `extraction_worker.rs` now collects genuinely-inserted facts (post-dedup, post-#812 filter) into `newly_inserted` and emits a `"memory-extracted"` Tauri event after each batch; (2) `ChatSidebar.svelte` registers a `listen('memory-extracted', ...)` handler that reads the Settings preference, picks the last surviving fact, formats `"💾 Remembered: {fact}"`, and starts a 5-second auto-fade timer; (3) `ChatPanel.svelte` wires the `memoryToast`/`memoryToastId` props it already declared (dead since #335) to the live display block — adds `✕ wrong` dismiss button (calls existing `ai_dismiss_memory` command) and `@keyframes toastFadeIn`; (4) `Settings.svelte` adds a `"Memory Toasts"` toggle (`pane_memory_toasts` localStorage key). No extraction behavior changed — toast plumbing only. `spec-skip: restoring §5.4B toast behavior that regressed in #335` `Relates to #641`
- **#1718 — Embedding pipeline: fixed potential panic on non-ASCII content exceeding the 2000-byte pre-filter threshold.** Raw byte slices `&content[..2000]` in the notes and chat-messages paths of `run_embedding_pipeline` could panic when byte 2000 fell inside a multi-byte UTF-8 character (CJK = 3 bytes/char, emoji = 4 bytes/char, accented Latin = 2 bytes/char). Replaced with `floor_char_boundary(2000)` — already the established codebase pattern (openrouter.rs, ollama.rs) — which walks back to the nearest valid char boundary with zero allocation. Behavior is unchanged for content ≤ 2000 bytes. (`Relates to #1718`) (`spec-skip: safety fix to existing truncation, no behavior change`)
- **#812 — Extraction output filter: drop AI-origin facts before `ai_memory` write (§5.4 step 3, launch-blocking).** Adds a mechanical filter in `extraction_worker.rs` running after `ai_extract_memory_with_db()` returns and before any DB write. Two signals: (a) model-produced `attribution` tag (`user` vs `assistant`) required in every extracted fact — assistant-tagged facts dropped; (b) mechanical subject/pattern backstop for `fact`/`reflection` categories matching first-person-AI prefixes ("I created", "I set", …), second-person-addressing-AI prefixes ("You asked me to", "The assistant", …), and tool-result restatements ("created a note", "set status", …). Signal (b) is best-effort — see #1711 for the durable fix. `attribution` field added to `MemoryEntry` (default: `"user"` for backward compat) and required in the extraction prompt. Extraction prompt updated to explain attribution tagging. Every dropped fact logs `[EXTRACTION-FILTERED]` for audit. Purely subtractive — does not change which user-origin facts are extracted. `Relates to #812` `spec-covered-by: #1712`
- **Consolidator startup waits up to 30s for provider readiness instead of blind 15s delay (#697)**
- **#695 — Consolidator prompt no longer hardcodes 'Matt is...' — templates actual user name from Identity note.** `parse_identity_name` (commands.rs) is now `pub(crate)` so `consolidate_file` can call it; the IDENTITY.md path is derived as a sibling of the memory file. Falls back to `"the user"` when IDENTITY.md is absent or has no parseable name. (#695)
- **#764 — Unbounded frontend retry loop when model produces empty display text.** `streamRetryCount` was unconditionally reset to 0 on every entry to `handleSendMessage`, including re-entry from the empty-response retry path. This defeated the `MAX_STREAM_RETRIES = 1` cap. Fixed by threading an `isRetry` flag through the retry call site so the counter is only reset for genuine user-initiated messages. (#764)
- **#1587 — Summarize on iteration cap/timeout.** When the agentic loop exits due to the iteration cap or wall-clock timeout, `ai_chat_stream` now makes one final LLM call (tools=[], spec §4.5.2 system message) and streams the summary on the same `stream_id` before emitting `done: true`. The summary is accumulated into `fullText` — no frontend changes needed. On summary call failure, the error is logged and the loop exits gracefully with partial text. (`spec-skip: summarization behavior implements §4.5.2 spec verbatim`; `spec-covered-by: #1691`; Relates to #1587)
- **#1588 — Wall-clock timeout for agentic loop.** `ai_chat_stream` now reads `loop_timeout_seconds` from `ai_settings`, clamped to 30–300, with fallback to 120 when absent or unparseable. The agentic loop breaks when elapsed wall time meets or exceeds the limit. (`spec-skip: settings read + timeout check mirrors #1689 pattern`; `spec-covered-by: #1691`; Relates to #1588)
- **#1589 — `max_tool_iterations` now read from `ai_settings` instead of hardcoded.** The agentic loop iteration cap was hardcoded as `10` in `ai_chat_stream`. Now reads from `ai_settings`, clamped to 1–30, fallback 10 when absent or unparseable. No Settings UI change. (spec-covered-by: #1688; Relates to #1589)
- **#1678 — `search_notes` is now hybrid FTS5 + semantic.** Conceptual queries (e.g. "early american leaders") now reach embedded notes, not just keyword matches. The semantic pass uses the same credential path (`embeddings_api_key`) and gate (`embeddings_enabled == "true"` AND `embeddings_status` in {ready, partial}) as `search_memory`. Source-filtered to notes only; deduped by `note_id`; FTS results appear first, semantic hits appended. Falls through to FTS-only when the gate is closed or credentials are missing. Return shape unchanged. (`spec-covered-by: #1681`; `Relates to #1678`)
- **#1679 — `search_memory` note results now include note UUID.** Both the FTS and semantic search paths were building note display strings as `[note] {title} [{status}]` with no UUID, making it impossible for the AI to chain directly to `read_note`. Now formatted as `[{uuid}] {title} [{status}]` — matching the `search_notes` output shape — so the UUID is available for immediate tool chaining. No struct, schema, or API changes. (Relates to #1679)
- **#1673 — Skip empty-body notes before embedding.** Date-stub notes (title=`2026-03-28`, empty file body) were passing the old `!content.trim().is_empty()` guard because the title alone is non-empty. OpenRouter returned HTTP 200 with `data: []` for trivial date strings, causing `"missing data[0].embedding"` errors on every pipeline run. Guard now checks `body_text.trim().is_empty()` (the file-content portion only), so title-only notes and stubs with empty files are skipped before `embed_fn` is called. Applied same emptiness guard to the facts sub-pass for consistency. (Relates to #1673)

### Added
- **AI Behavior card** in Settings → AI tab: configurable max tool iterations (1–30) and loop timeout (30–300s) with clamp-on-blur validation (`spec-covered-by: #1691`; Relates to #1589)
- **AI Behavior card spacing fix** — right padding on number inputs to prevent crowding against scrollbar (Relates to #1589)
- **#1674 — Embedding index counts persist across Settings reopens + partial failure surfacing.** Settings → AI → Semantic Search now shows correct index totals on every open via a live `get_embeddings_counts` Tauri command (`SELECT source, COUNT(*) FROM embeddings GROUP BY source`) — counts are never stale across sessions. Embedding pipeline now tracks `failed_count` (transient API errors; not skips or auth aborts); on completion, status becomes `"partial"` (yellow dot + “Ready (with warnings)” + failed count) when any items failed, or `"ready"` when clean. `embeddings_failed_count` is persisted to `ai_settings` so the count survives restarts. Auth aborts still surface as `"error"` and leave prior state intact. (`spec-skip: Bug fix — adds count display and failure surfacing to existing embedding status UI. No behavioral spec change.`; `Relates to #1674`)
- **#1657 — Semantic Search settings card (Settings → AI) with master toggle, provider selection (OpenRouter/Ollama), embedding-model picker, index-status row, and provider-switch confirm modal. Fixed `switch_embedding_engine` to release the DB lock before running the embedding pipeline — main mutex is now held for milliseconds (settings persist + credential read), not for the full indexing run. Pipeline emits granular `embeddings://status` events via `AppHandle` for real-time status updates in the UI. [3/3].** (`spec-skip: spec already landed in PR #1656 and #1658`; `spec-covered-by: #1656 (§5.9/ADR-0048) and #1658 (local engine removal amendment)`; `Relates to #1657`)
- **#1657 — Multi-engine HTTP embedding backend — OpenRouter and Ollama via HTTP [2/3].** `embed_fn` wired into startup pipeline (lib.rs SCOPE 2) and `search_memory` semantic branch (commands.rs). Engine switch (`switch_embedding_engine` Tauri command) clears stale cross-engine vectors and re-indexes under the new engine. Semantic gate requires both `embeddings_enabled == "true"` AND `embeddings_status == "ready"`. New `embeddings_engine` and `embeddings_model` ai_settings keys. Schema v65→v66: `engine TEXT` column added to `embeddings` table to tag rows by backend. `build_http_embed_fn` constructs the closure (OpenRouter: OpenAI-compatible `/api/v1/embeddings`; Ollama: `/api/embed`); `embeddings.rs` stays HTTP-backend-agnostic. No UI in this PR — keys set via DB. (§5.9 + ADR-0048; `spec-skip: spec already landed in PR #1656 and #1658`; `spec-covered-by: #1656 (§5.9/ADR-0048) and #1658 (local engine removal amendment)`; `Relates to #1657`)
- **#637 — Embedding progress events via `embeddings://status` Tauri event.** The embedding pipeline (model download + indexing) now emits granular progress to the frontend via a single `embeddings://status` event with a `stage` discriminant. Stages: `ram_check`, `downloading` (per file, from callback), `loading`, `indexing` (every 25 items, throttled, via callback), `ready`, `error`, and `disabled`. `embeddings.rs` stays Tauri-free (ADR-0047) — it reports progress through a caller-supplied `Fn(EmbeddingProgress)` callback; `lib.rs` owns the `AppHandle::emit` call. Coarse stages (ram_check, loading, ready, error, disabled) are emitted directly at their call sites. The durable `ai_settings.embeddings_status` remains the authoritative terminal-state source of truth; events are transient IPC only. Unified embedding events on single `embeddings://status` channel (spec-compliant). (`spec-skip: spec already landed in PR #1654`, `spec-covered-by: #1654 (docs/spec/637-embedding-progress-events.md + ADR-0047)`, `Relates to #637`)
- **memory-pipeline.md §5.7.3 (amended):** `search_notes` is now hybrid — FTS5 keyword match + semantic (embedding) search merged into one result set, matching the §5.9 pattern used by `search_memory`. FTS5 remains the always-on baseline; the semantic pass is gated identically to `search_memory` (`embeddings_enabled == "true"` AND `embeddings_status` in {ready, partial}), FTS-only otherwise. Removes the prior "search_notes is FTS-only / semantic is search_memory's concern" language. Return shape unchanged (`note_id` + `title` + `content_preview`); semantic results merge into the same shape. (Relates to #638, #1678)
- **memory-pipeline.md §5.9 Hybrid ranking:** Gate wording reconciled — `embeddings_status == "ready"` → `embeddings_status` is `"ready"` or `"partial"`, matching shipped code (#1676) and §5.7.3/§5.9.4. (Relates to #1674)
- **memory-pipeline.md §5.9.2:** Replaced "Key reuse (UX intent)" paragraph with "Credential source" — the Semantic Search card's own credential field is the authoritative embeddings credential, not the primary-provider or internal-provider slot. Pre-filled from Smart Features as convenience, but the card field is source of truth. Documents #1657 bug root cause. (Relates to #1657)
- **memory-pipeline.md §5.9 + ADR-0048:** semantic search redesigned from auto-download/RAM-auto-enable (#66) to opt-in, default OFF. FTS5 remains the always-on default for all users. New Settings → AI → Semantic Search toggle; nothing downloads or indexes until the user enables it and picks an engine (local bge-base-en-v1.5 / Ollama / OpenRouter). Anthropic has no embeddings API (local or Ollama only unless an OR key is added). Engine switch invalidates the index → full re-index. `embeddings_enabled` defaults false (no longer RAM-derived); `embeddings_status` semantic gate unchanged downstream. #637 progress badge renders inside the opt-in section. ADR-0048 supersedes #66. (Relates to #66, #637)
- **memory-pipeline.md §5.9 + ADR-0048 (amended in place, pre-build):** local `bge-base-en-v1.5` embedding engine removed. Semantic search is OpenRouter or Ollama only, both via HTTP to the provider's embeddings endpoint — Pane runs no model in-process and downloads nothing. Ollama is the privacy path. Re-index-on-switch retained (OR/Ollama dimensions still differ). Progress stages reduce to off → indexing → ready/error (#637 download/loading stages don't apply to this flow). Dropping the local engine removes the candle/tokenizers native-ML dependency (binary-size win). (Relates to #66, #637)
- **New `docs/spec/637-embedding-progress-events.md` + ADR-0047:** Tauri event contract for the embedding pipeline. Single `embeddings://status` event with a `stage` discriminant (ram_check/downloading/loading/indexing/ready/error/disabled) and full payload schema; per-stage emit locations; `indexing` throttled to every 25 items. Library-boundary decision: `embeddings.rs` stays Tauri-free, reporting progress via a callback while `lib.rs` owns the emit (ADR-0047). Frontend renders per stage and never blocks FTS search; `ai_settings.embeddings_status` remains the durable terminal-state source of truth, events are transient IPC. (Relates to #637)
- **memory-pipeline.md §5.7 + new §5.7.3:** `search_notes` content-search contract. `search_notes` MUST query `notes_fts` via FTS5 MATCH (not `title LIKE`) and return `note_id` + `content_preview` snippet (not bare title strings), so the AI can navigate to matched notes. Clarifies `search_notes` as the AI's note-content path over `notes_fts`; `ai_memory`/chat/archive remain `search_memory`'s surfaces. Corrects the title-only bug. `search_notes`-vs-`search_memory` boundary (#765) held separate. (Relates to #638)

(§5.9 + ADR-0048; spec-skip: spec already landed in PR #1656 and #1658; spec-covered-by: #1656 (§5.9/ADR-0048) and #1658 (local engine removal amendment); Relates to #1657)

The Settings UI pre-fills from the Smart Features key when no card credential is saved yet. - **#1657 — Embedding-model picker now shows only embedding models.** OpenRouter is filtered via `?output_modalities=embeddings` (OR-maintained server-side allowlist). Ollama is filtered by a two-signal heuristic: `details.family` contains `"bert"` (covers nomic-embed-text, mxbai-embed-large, all-minilm) OR model name contains `"embed"` (covers bge-m3, snowflake-arctic-embed). Chat models (llama, mistral, phi, gemma, etc.) are excluded. Prevents selecting a chat model as the embedding model, which caused 401 errors on every embed call. - **#638 — `search_notes` now uses FTS5 MATCH instead of `title LIKE`.** `execute_search_notes` previously ran a `title LIKE` query, returning only bare title strings useless for navigation. Replaced with FTS5 MATCH against `notes_fts`, joining back to `notes` for metadata. Return shape now includes `note_id` (for AI navigation), `title`, `content_preview` (FTS5 `snippet()` on the body column), `project_id`, and `status`. Queries are sanitized per the `execute_search_memory` pattern. Ordered by `fts.rank`. No embedding dependency — FTS-only. (`spec-covered-by: #1650 (§5.7.3 search_notes Content-Search Contract)`, `Relates to #638`)
- **#1640 — Settings: "Add credits →" link shown for OR billing errors.** When `validate_openrouter_key` returns a billing error (message contains `openrouter.ai/settings/credits`), Settings now renders a clickable "Add credits →" link below the error — both in the primary-provider error display and the internal-provider (Smart Features) error display. Mirrors the Onboarding pattern (§6.3.1). (`spec-covered-by: §28.2`, `Relates to #1640`)
- **#1630 — Primary-provider validation gate: bad OR/Anthropic/Ollama key no longer shows green "Connected".** `saveAndTest()` (primary AI path) now validates before calling `ai_configure_and_save`. On validation failure: `connectionStatus = 'error'`, `ai_configure_and_save` is NOT called (bad config is not saved). OpenClaw is unchanged — validated inside `ai_configure_and_save` via `fetch_oc_agent_model`. Both streaming and non-streaming OR paths return billing-specific copy with propagation-delay hint. INVARIANTS.md mirror line added. (`spec-covered-by: #1631 (§4.3.2 OpenRouter billing-error handling)`, `spec-skip: spec already landed in PR #1631`, `Relates to #993`)

Previously both cases returned "Invalid API key." Onboarding error surface gains an "Add credits →" link when the billing copy is shown. (`spec-covered-by: #1631 (§6.3.1 validator contract)`, `spec-skip: spec already landed in PR #1631`, `Relates to #993`)

Corrects the OC-path 402-enters-reconnect behavior. (Relates to #993)
